primary_endpoint: Mean relative reduction from baseline in liver fat content at Week 28; adverse events and discontinuations due to AEs were also primary outcomes.
efficacy_outcome: Mean liver-fat reduction at Week 28: 67.8% with Q1W 10 mg, 54.4% with Q2W 10 mg, and 42.1% with Q2W 15 mg; statistical comparisons were not reported.
safety_signal: AEs occurred in 83.3%, 82.1%, and 85.7%, respectively; discontinuations due to AEs occurred in 7.1%, 5.1%, and 9.5%. Serious AEs affected 3/42, 2/39, and 4/42 participants, respectively; no deaths.
